{{Clear}}
==Usage==
To use this template, paste <code><nowiki>{{</nowiki>UserDiscord|{{Var|username}}|{{Var|nickname}}}}</code> into your user page.

===Required parameters===
#{{Para||{{Var|username}}}} Your Discord username.

===Optional parameters===
#<li value="2">{{Para||{{Var|nickname}}}} Your Discord profile name, which on [[Wookieepedia]]'s [[Wookieepedia:Discord|Discord server]] should just display as your username.</li>
